sloka: उपवासैः च योगैः च बहुभिः च परिश्रमैः ।दुह्खम् सम्वर्धितः मोघम् त्वम् हि दुर्गतया मया ॥२-२०-४८॥
transliteration: upavāsaiḥ ca yogaiḥ ca bahubhiḥ ca pariśramaiḥ ।duhkham samvardhitaḥ mogham tvam hi durgatayā mayā ॥2-20-48॥

translations.english: Through meditation, through fasts and with a great deal of efforts you have been brought up by this luckless (mother). But alas this is all in vain.
